summary: Full-stack E2E verification of DashBite. Backend: 21/21 pytest passed (health, home, 8 seeded restaurants, cuisine filter, restaurant+menu details, search restaurants+dishes, auth register/login/wrong-password/me, address CRUD, COD order create with exact bill math, mixed-restaurant & empty-cart rejection, ownership). WebSocket verified via python client: init CONFIRMED -> PREPARING @15s -> OUT_FOR_DELIVERY @40s. Frontend (Expo web, mobile viewport): all 15 requested flows passed - splash->onboarding->guest home, home header/chips (8->1 biryani filter)/banners/cards, search restaurants+dishes+dish ADD, restaurant details + item modal (qty/notes/add), cart bill math (987+35+49=1071), guest orders login prompt, guest checkout login redirect, wrong-password error, register, login test@dashbite.in, address add/list/select, COD checkout (329+35+16+tip20=400) -> order-confirmation #EA34C94D, orders tab Active+Confirmed badge, order details (items/timeline/bill/address), live track (LIVE badge, Confirmed->Preparing@15s->On the way@40s, rider card, ETA countdown), profile rows + logout, help FAQ accordion + search filter. Pay Online option renders (not tested further per known Razorpay 401). No deprecated expo packages, no red screens, no unexpected console errors.

issues: No view-cart bar after adding a dish from search - user must switch to Home tab (or restaurant page) to reach cart. Minor UX gap; home tab's cart bar stays mounted in DOM behind search screen (inactive tabs remain mounted on web), which also confuses test automation selectors.

action_items: Optional UX: render a view-cart bar (or cart entry point) on the Search tab after items are added from dish search results.
Optional: fix react-native-web console warnings (shadow* props -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents deprecation) - cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is exactly 702 lines - at the split threshold; consider modularizing (routes/services) if more endpoints are added.
Order simulation resumes correctly after server restart via startup hook - good.
ObjectId handling, _id exclusion, JWT auth, bill recomputation server-side (client totals not trusted), single-restaurant enforcement, and idempotent payment verify are all correctly implemented.
testID coverage is excellent across all interactive elements.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_dashbite_api.py as regression suite (BASE_URL hardcoded to https://feastwave.preview.emergentagent.com in conftest.py). Playwright notes: (1) inactive tab screens stay mounted in DOM - scope selectors to the active screen or use first-match carefully; view-cart-bar exists only on Home and Restaurant screens, NOT on Search. (2) Never force-click list buttons while FlatList is re-rendering (rows shift - use precise non-force clicks after settle waits). (3) Each browser_automation run is a fresh context - re-login and re-add cart items per run, or place orders via page.evaluate fetch with token from localStorage key 'dashbite_token'.
